review_description: There was no high-pitched sales pitch or putting down others.  Just told us the facts.Appreciated his comments. It is his own business so hopefully would want to do the best so as to not bring disrepute to his business.

A great quality system along with fantstic customer service from genuine people.  They went out of their way to squueeeeeze us in before the deadline for the grant, advised us how to get the best value out of our system and how to best set it up for our circumstances.  This will save us even more thousands than we had anticipated. We are very happy customers.
Warranty on the differing components was very important
I have recommended Eco Soul Power to 2 other couples intending to get solar panels.
